{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Long maxi skirt, A-line, floor-grazing length, deep plum (#5B2A4E), soft crepe with a fluid drape
Fitted blouse, long sleeves, V-neckline, hip length, ivory (#F2EBDD), silk-satin
Textured cardigan-style jacket, cropped, collarless, charcoal (#3A3A40), bouclé wool blend
Pumps, block heel about 5 cm, almond toe, black (#1C1C1E), smooth leather
Clutch, small envelope shape, deep burgundy (#4A1C2C), soft leather
Drop earrings, small, antique gold (#B08D57), polished metal
Thin belt, narrow, at the waist, black (#1C1C1E), leather

Why this outfit works: The flowing plum maxi skirt gives the long silhouette you asked for and feels right for an autumn evening at the theatre. The ivory satin blouse and the textured charcoal jacket keep the look neat and polished without being too formal. The block heel of about 5 cm sits within your preferred heel range and stays comfortable through a long performance. Warm gold earrings and a burgundy clutch pick up the rich tones of the skirt and glow nicely under artificial evening light."}
